LABEL: antral follicle
Definition: An ovarian follicle characterized by the presence of a fluid-filled cavity called the antrum that develops during folliculogenesis.

LABEL: central inferior ovary
Definition: An anatomical subdivision of the ovarian medulla that is located in the inferior (lower) portion of the central ovarian region, containing vascular stroma, blood vessels, lymphatic vessels, and nerves.

LABEL: central ovary
Definition: An organ part that is the central region of the ovary, positioned between the lateral and medial aspects and encompassing tissue from both cortex and medulla in the mid-region of the organ.

LABEL: central superior antimesenteric ovary
Definition: An anatomical region of the ovary corresponding to the central-mediolateral and superior-inferosuperior portion of the free border (antimesenteric side) opposite to the mesovarium attachment.

LABEL: central superior mesenteric ovary
Definition: An anatomical region of the ovary corresponding to the central-mediolateral and superior-inferosuperior portion of the hilar border (mesenteric side) adjacent to the mesovarium attachment.

LABEL: central superior ovary
Definition: An anatomical subdivision of the ovarian medulla that is located in the superior (upper) portion of the central ovarian region, containing vascular stroma, blood vessels, lymphatic vessels, and nerves.

LABEL: corona radiata
Definition: A cell layer of granulosa cells that radiates outward from the zona pellucida surrounding the oocyte within an ovarian follicle. The corona radiata consists of specialized granulosa cells arranged in a radial pattern, forming the outermost cellular layer directly adjacent to the zona pellucida. This structure is expelled with the oocyte during ovulation and must be penetrated by sperm for successful fertilization to occur.

LABEL: corpus luteum granulosa lutein layer
Definition: A cell layer of the corpus luteum that consists of large luteinized granulosa cells derived from the granulosa cell layer of the preovulatory follicle and forms the inner layer of the corpus luteum.

LABEL: corpus luteum theca lutein layer
Definition: A cell layer of the corpus luteum that consists of luteinized theca cells derived from the theca cell layer of the preovulatory follicle and forms the outer layer of the corpus luteum.

LABEL: cortical blood vessels
Definition: A blood vessel that is located in the ovarian cortex, supplying oxygenated blood to the follicles and connective tissue stroma within the cortical region of the ovary.

LABEL: cumulus oophorus oocyte complex
Definition: A multicellular anatomical structure consisting of an oocyte surrounded by layers of cumulus oophorus cells (cumulus cells) within the ovarian follicle, released as a functional unit during ovulation and required for fertilization.

LABEL: dominant antral follicle
Definition: A tertiary ovarian follicle that has been selected for continued growth and maturation through preferential responsiveness to follicle-stimulating hormone, typically becoming the single follicle that will ovulate during a menstrual cycle.

LABEL: early antral follicle
Definition: A tertiary ovarian follicle at the initial stage of antrum formation, characterized by the presence of small fluid-filled spaces between granulosa cells that have begun to coalesce.

LABEL: lateral inferior antimesenteric ovary
Definition: An anatomical subdivision of the ovary located in the lateral and inferior region, specifically on the antimesenteric side (the side opposite to the mesovarium, the peritoneal fold that attaches the ovary to the broad ligament).

LABEL: lateral inferior mesenteric ovary
Definition: An anatomical subdivision of the ovary located in the lateral and inferior region, specifically on the mesenteric side (the side adjacent to the mesovarium, the peritoneal fold that attaches the ovary to the broad ligament).

LABEL: lateral ovary
Definition: An organ part that is the lateral region of the ovary, comprising the outer aspect of the organ oriented away from the midline of the body.

LABEL: medial inferior ovary
Definition: A spatial subdivision of the ovary representing the inferior (caudal) region of its medial (midline-facing) surface, defined by coordinate-based anatomical mapping rather than distinct histological or functional boundaries.

LABEL: medial ovary
Definition: An organ part that is the medial region of the ovary, comprising the inner aspect of the organ oriented toward the midline of the body.

LABEL: medial superior antimesenteric ovary
Definition: An organ part of the ovary that is located in the medial and superior region on the antimesenteric side, which is the side opposite to the hilum where the ovarian ligament attaches to the uterus via the mesovarium.

LABEL: medial superior mesenteric ovary
Definition: An organ part of the ovary that is located in the medial and superior region on the mesenteric side, which is the side adjacent to the hilum where the ovarian ligament and mesovarium attach and through which blood vessels and nerves enter the ovary.

LABEL: medial superior ovary
Definition: A spatial subdivision of the ovary representing the superior (cranial) region of its medial (midline-facing) surface, defined by coordinate-based anatomical mapping rather than distinct histological or functional boundaries.

LABEL: multilayer ovarian follicle
Definition: An ovarian follicle characterized by the presence of two or more layers of granulosa cells surrounding the oocyte, representing a stage of folliculogenesis between primary and antral follicle development.

LABEL: ovarian corticomedullary junction
Definition: An anatomical junction that is the boundary between the ovarian cortex and the ovarian medulla, located in the ovary.

LABEL: ovarian medullary vasculature
Definition: A vasculature that is part of the ovarian medulla. This network of blood vessels provides vascular supply to the highly vascularized stroma of the ovarian medulla and forms the tissue of the hilum through which blood vessels enter the ovary.

LABEL: pre-selection antral follicle
Definition: A tertiary ovarian follicle in the stage prior to follicle selection, characterized by continued growth but not yet exhibiting the preferential responsiveness to gonadotropins that distinguishes the dominant follicle.

LABEL: pre-selection antral follicle
Definition: A tertiary ovarian follicle in the stage prior to follicle selection, characterized by continued growth but not yet exhibiting the preferential responsiveness to gonadotropins that distinguishes the dominant follicle.

LABEL: preantral follicle
Definition: A maturing ovarian follicle with multiple layers of granulosa cells that has not yet developed an antral cavity.

LABEL: selection antral follicle
Definition: A tertiary ovarian follicle undergoing the selection process during which one follicle becomes dominant through differential expression of gonadotropin receptors and enhanced responsiveness to follicle-stimulating hormone.

LABEL: transitional primary ovarian follicle
Definition: A primary ovarian follicle in an intermediate stage of development, characterized by granulosa cells transitioning from flattened to cuboidal morphology, representing the developmental transition from primordial to fully established primary follicle.

LABEL: transitional primordial ovarian follicle
Definition: A primordial ovarian follicle in an early or transitional stage of development, representing the initial activation of dormant primordial follicles toward primary follicle formation.

LABEL: pancreatic extracellular matrix
Definition: An acellular anatomical structure that consists of a network of extracellular macromolecules and minerals, including collagen, enzymes, and glycoproteins, that provides structural and biochemical support to pancreatic cells.

LABEL: small intestine connective tissue
Definition: A connective tissue that forms the structural framework and support of the small intestine, comprising the lamina propria within the mucosa, the submucosa layer containing blood vessels and nerves, the serosa covering the outer surface, and the mesentery providing vascular support.
